detail.longDescription: # Seafile is so advanced! It works the same way as iCloud on # macOS . You can see all your storage, but it downloads only the files you use or edit. On mobile, I can open a file from Seafile in any app for editing, and it will be synced after that. That's just rocks! Can't believe I didn't try it earlier. Also, the # SelfHosted Pro version is free for up to 3 users. # SelfHost # Selfhosting # Homelab # Files
